description: This file contains implementation of statistical functions related to chi-square distribution, including calculation of chi-square critical values and p-values, using methods like polynomial evaluation, normal approximation, and bisection search.

methods.name: EvaluatePolynomial
methods.description: Evaluates a polynomial at a given point using Horner's method.

methods.name: POZ
methods.description: Calculates the probability of a normal z-value.

methods.name: normal_survival
methods.description: Approximates the survival function of the normal distribution.

methods.name: ChiSquareValue
methods.description: Calculates the critical chi-square value for given degrees of freedom and p-value.

methods.name: ChiSquarePValue
methods.description: Calculates the p-value for a given chi-square statistic and degrees of freedom.
